title: Returns & Income
description: What your money earned: dividends and interest over time and by source, plus realized capital gains on sales. NOTE: the realized-gains section is derived from your ledger and is NOT a tax document — it applies no wash-sale rules or broker lot-selection, so it can differ from your 1099-B. For tax, use your broker's 1099-B / official statements.

widgets.title: Income (dividends + interest)
widgets.helpText: All dividend and interest income received to date, per currency. This is the honest total across every source — no 'is this investment interest' decision.

steps.query: SELECT currency, ROUND(SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * -1, 2) AS amount FROM postings WHERE (account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' OR account LIKE 'Income:Interest%') AND (:currency = '*' OR currency = :currency) AND transaction_date <= :asOf GROUP BY currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY currency

widgets.title: Realized Gain
widgets.helpText: Total realized capital gain/loss on sold holdings, per currency. Ledger-derived, NOT for tax filing.

steps.query: SELECT price_currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL))), 2) AS amount FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency WHERE c.is_currency = 0 AND p.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.price_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.amount AS REAL) < 0 AND transaction_date <= :asOf AND (:currency = '*' OR price_currency = :currency) GROUP BY price_currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY price_currency

widgets.title: Income Over Time
widgets.helpText: Dividends and interest received each year through the selected date, in the selected currency.

steps.query: SELECT CAST(year AS TEXT) AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' THEN CAST(amount AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) * -1, 2) AS dividends, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN account LIKE 'Income:Interest%' THEN CAST(amount AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) * -1, 2) AS interest FROM postings WHERE (account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' OR account LIKE 'Income:Interest%') AND currency = :currency AND transaction_date <= :asOf GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

visualization.emptyText: No dividend or interest income in this currency yet.

widgets.title: Income by Source
widgets.helpText: Which accounts your income came from through the selected date, largest first. Shows every currency; each currency totals separately.

steps.query: SELECT account AS source, currency, ROUND(SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * -1, 2) AS amount FROM postings WHERE (account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' OR account LIKE 'Income:Interest%') AND (:currency = '*' OR currency = :currency) AND transaction_date <= :asOf GROUP BY account, currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY currency, amount DESC

widgets.title: Realized Gain by Year (short vs long term)
widgets.helpText: Realized capital gain per year in the selected currency, split by holding period (held over one year = long term). Ledger-derived, NOT a tax document.

steps.query: SELECT CAST(year AS TEXT) AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(cost_date) > 365 THEN ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL)) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS long_term, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(cost_date) <= 365 THEN ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL)) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS short_term FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency WHERE c.is_currency = 0 AND p.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.price_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.amount AS REAL) < 0 AND p.price_currency = :currency GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

visualization.emptyText: No sales recorded in this currency. (Ledger-derived, not a tax document.)

widgets.title: Sales
widgets.helpText: Every sale: sale date, the lot's acquisition date, holding period, cost basis, proceeds, and realized gain. Consolidated across accounts; shows every currency. Ledger-derived — for tax, use your broker's 1099-B.

steps.query: SELECT transaction_date AS sale_date, p.currency AS holding, price_currency AS currency, ROUND(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)), 4) AS units, cost_date AS acquired, CAST(julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(cost_date) AS INTEGER) AS holding_days, CASE WHEN julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(cost_date) > 365 THEN 'Long' ELSE 'Short' END AS term, ROUND(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * CAST(cost_amount AS REAL), 2) AS cost_basis, ROUND(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * CAST(price_amount AS REAL), 2) AS proceeds, ROUND(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL)), 2) AS gain FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency WHERE c.is_currency = 0 AND p.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.price_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.amount AS REAL) < 0 AND (:currency = '*' OR p.price_currency = :currency) ORDER BY transaction_date DESC

visualization.emptyText: No sales recorded. (Ledger-derived; not a tax document.)
